title: Prosecution ‘very happy’ after defense presents AMLC expert witness
summary: After the defense presented its expert witness, CPA-lawyer and former AMLC investigator Atty. Rainer dela Fuente, prosecutors said they are ‘very happy’ with how Thursday’s hearing unfolded.
